caption: The drawing depicts an industrial interior, primarily in shades of gray and muted green, with accents of brown and metallic hues. The central focus is a large, rectangular metallic chamber or booth with riveted edges and a heavy door labeled "S.A.T." and "AMERICAN FOUNDRY EQUIPMENT CO. MISHAWAKA, INDIANA." Several thick metal ducts and pipes, colored gray and silver, curve into and out of the chamber, extending across the ceiling and throughout the room. To the left of the chamber is a metal filtration or ventilation system composed of several cylindrical tanks and more pipes, surrounded by a green metal safety railing. In front of the chamber sits a brown wooden dolly on wheels labeled "SERVICE CART, SAND DOLLAR, UNITED STATES." To the right, a green-framed cart holds a square metallic container labeled "SAND BLASTING DEPT." In the far right corner, there is a wooden desk with an open ledger or book, a chair, and above it, a calendar showing a woman in a swimsuit. A sign on the wall above the desk reads "ACCIDENTS DON'T PAY, WATCH THE HAND YOU MAN ON." The room has large windows along the left and right sides, admitting daylight, and three green industrial ceiling lamps hang from the white-raftered ceiling. The floors are gray concrete, and various tools and canisters are visible on the ground near the left side of the scene.
title: Interior Sand Blasting Chamber, 1935
